verdict.rationale: Factory's droid exec is explicitly designed to run as a one-shot command 'ideal for CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts, and batch processing,' implying it can be wired into external schedulers/cron jobs, and Missions/Software Factory provide broader workflow orchestration. However, there is no documented native recurring-job scheduler, cron-like trigger, or built-in automation-schedule feature within Factory itself. Missing for 10: a first-party scheduling/trigger mechanism, docs on recurring execution, and evidence of scheduled Mission runs rather than manual/CI-triggered ones.
